c1.note: CNBC, Reuters and Fox confirm about 1,000 North America job cuts announced Nov 9, 2026; variant F's 'according to reports' wording is also supported.

c3.note: CNBC and Reuters cite a Monday (Nov 9) letter from Ram Krishnan to employees.

c6.note: Reuters and CNBC both say the cuts occur over the next week; Bloomberg quotes 'Over the coming week'.

c7.note: CNBC says the aim is to streamline operations and better connect teams across North America.

c9.note: CNBC lead: cutting jobs as it tries to turn around lagging sales in its home market.

c10.note: Fox Business says the cuts come as PepsiCo streamlines and improves performance amid weaker demand and rising costs.

c11.note: CNBC and Fox both say the WSJ first reported the layoffs.

c12.note: Reuters reported 'some jobs' in the NA food and beverage business and said the WSJ reported around 1,000.

c14.note: Reuters' own text says 'some jobs' and attributes the ~1,000 figure to the WSJ.

c15.note: Sources describe 'plans to cut' and 'planned layoffs' expected over the next week; no source has a verified completed count.

c16.note: The figure is sourced to WSJ and an internal letter obtained by Reuters and CNBC, and none of the saved pages quote a company release or filing stating it.

c19.note: Fox Business states the company has not publicly identified which locations or departments are affected.

c21.note: Fox says PepsiCo lowered its 2026 core EPS growth forecast in October, citing weaker beverage volumes, snack demand pressure and higher costs.

c23.note: CNBC says North American beverage volume shrank 2% in Q3.

c24.note: CNBC says North American food volume was flat in Q3.

c25.note: CNBC attributes the statement that the turnaround is taking longer than expected to CFO Steve Schmitt on the earnings call. The wording is paraphrased, not a direct quote.

c26.note: Reuters cites the annual report for about 306,000 employees as of Dec 27, 2025.

c27.note: Reuters cites the annual report for roughly 125,000 U.S. employees as of Dec 27, 2025.

c28.note: 1,000 divided by 125,000 is 0.8%, and the cuts are across North America rather than only the U.S., so this is a rough illustrative ratio.

c29.note: The quote appears in CNBC's coverage of Krishnan's letter.

c31.note: The PepsiCo release says it is reducing nearly 20% of U.S. SKUs by early next year and cites plant closures and line shutdowns. The 'three plants' count is not visible in the excerpt, but the passage is consistent with the claim.

c32.note: The release says it 'follows constructive engagement with supportive PepsiCo shareholder Elliott Investment Management'.

c33.note: The release says it intends to give a comprehensive update on North America supply chain and go-to-market optimization in late 2026. 'Further restructuring possible' is a reasonable inference.

c34.note: PepsiCo's own release dated October 19, 2026 announces the immediate closure of the Knoxville plant.

c35.note: The release promises a paid notice period through January 1, with continued pay and benefits and access to transition resources.

c36.note: Food Dive reports 112 workers laid off and cites a WARN notice.

c37.note: MarketScreener (S&P Capital IQ) and Reuters/CNBC report about 1,000 job cuts across North American food and beverage.

c38.note: MarketScreener says the cuts 'should be viewed as part of this broader restructuring effort rather than as a separately quantified cost-saving target'. That is the outlet's own framing.

c39.note: MarketScreener says the turnaround gained momentum after Elliott took a roughly $4B stake in 2025. Reuters and Fox Business also report the roughly $4B stake.

c40.note: The ailayoffs.org tracker was not seen, but Food Dive links a September 16, 2026 story on PepsiCo ending manufacturing at a Maryland bottling plant with layoffs. That corroborates the earlier smaller cuts; Cheverly is not confirmed in the excerpts.

c6.note: Reuters and CNBC (Nov 9, 2026): Krishnan's letter says the cuts are expected over the next week, to simplify the company's structure.

c12.note: Reuters (Nov 9) reported job cuts to streamline the North America food and beverage unit and said the WSJ put the figure at about 1,000.

c15.note: Reports describe planned cuts happening over the next week. No source gives a count of completed layoffs.

c22.note: CNBC, Reuters and Fox: PepsiCo lowered its FY2026 earnings outlook on Oct 8, 2026, to 2.5–3.5% core EPS growth.

c24.note: CNBC: North American food volume was flat in Q3 and beverage volume fell 2%.

c25.note: CNBC says Schmitt said this on the earnings call, but it is CNBC's paraphrase, not a direct quote.

c34.note: PepsiCo press release dated Oct 19, 2026 announces the immediate closure of the Knoxville, TN plant.
